working_hypothesis: Bidirectional DShot ESC telemetry occasionally returns decoded eRPM values in a physically impossible band (~28k–59k RPM) while the optical deck stays near true hover RPM (~11–17k). Values often appear in 1–2 tick bursts (2–4 ms at 500 Hz log rate; control reads the same motor.* log at 1 kHz). Pattern fits intermittent telemetry-slot or decode glitches, not true rotor acceleration — no clean correlation with commanded PWM step found in this pass (motor PWM changes are smooth at spike neighbors).
